summary: Re-ran the flattened routed-datapath compare under klt 0.9.1 with options.anchor_top_level_pins false (the one-option change proposed in the r7 analysis). Verdict unchanged: mismatch. Matched counts fell slightly (devices 38 vs 43, nets 160 vs 174) and net.split/net.merged rose by about 90, so top-level pin anchoring is not the cause of the net-level disagreement; it was helping, not hurting.
